entries.title: Distance makes things look better
entries.odia: ଦୂର ପର୍ବତ ସୁନ୍ଦର; ଦୂର ବନ୍ଧୁ ସୁନ୍ଦର
entries.literal_meaning: A distant mountain is beautiful; a distant friend is beautiful.
entries.explanation: Distance can hide the rough edges of a place or a relationship. What looks inviting from afar may feel different when we know its everyday difficulties. The saying gently questions an ideal picture; it does not claim that friendship needs distance.
entries.meaning_odia: ଦୂରରୁ ଦେଖିଲେ ପାହାଡ଼ର ଅସୁବିଧା ଦିଶେ ନାହିଁ; ଦୂରରେ ଥିବା ବନ୍ଧୁଙ୍କ ଦୋଷ ବି ସହଜରେ ଆଖିରେ ପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ। ନିକଟରୁ ଜାଣିଲେ ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ ଅସୁବିଧା ଓ ଦୁର୍ବଳତା ଜଣାପଡ଼େ—ଏହି ତଫାତକୁ କଥାଟି ସୂଚାଏ।
entries.usage_example: Someone envies a friend’s life from holiday photographs; a longer visit reveals ordinary chores and worries too. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary gives two parallel images: a mountain seen from afar and a friend kept at a distance. This explanation is an editorial reading of that contrast, not an origin story.
